_todo: OQ-ART-WORLD (M2W1 item 4): the ground's detail look. Every number and colour is an art trial on alesia_1km, not a design value.
_note: Read by WorldSurface.ground_material when the graphics preset has art_ground_detail_enabled (off: the S2 ground exactly). Keys in "uniforms" are the uniform names of scripts/visual/shaders/ground.gdshader (colours are sRGB); rock_layer_name is a data/art_materials.json layer name; rock_tile_m becomes rock_tiles_per_m. Never put these in art_materials.json "ground" (its keys are hashed into the ground paint inputs). Scales: detail_large_m / detail_mid_m / detail_near_m are the noise tiles (the 360 m tile's macro channel makes ~60 m patches, the 90 m tile's ~15 m patches and ~2-3 m grain). Slopes: 1 - normal.y (0.06 ~ 20 deg, 0.12 ~ 28 deg; the citadel hill's steepest is 29 deg).
